title: Granular engine loading and lean Hybrid feasibility

definition.hypothesis: Qualified smaller engine bundles and deferred codec loading reduce initial work while retaining correct output and full fallback.
definition.baseline: Frozen screen-01 runtime, matched Hybrid and Software builds; matched static decoder for the side-module probe.
definition.success_criteria: At least 20% gzip component reduction and 10% plus 100ms median startup saving after profile-specific correctness.
definition.stop_criteria: Wrong output, lost fallback, or setup exceeding the bounded experiment.
definition.primary_metric: Compressed bytes and selection-to-verified startup milliseconds.
definition.negative_control: Wrong picture oracle; Firefox unsupported HEVC fallback.
definition.effort_limit: User-authorized full feasibility study; seven stages completed at whole-player and component levels.

define.basis: Full plan and HEVC follow-up predeclared before their builds/measurements.

prepare.basis: Frozen inputs, sources, fixtures, independent references and exact compiler/runtime records.

screen.basis: Admission fix, finite Software profiles and actual PIC side-module variants built and exercised.

correctness.basis: Qualified primary profiles pass independent pictures, audio, lifecycle and fallback gates. Rejected common-v1 AV1 and baseline VP8 color limitation remain explicit; this is not all-codec release qualification.

performance.basis: 44 sequential paired timing trials after primary-profile gates; preparation/cache/recovery and codec-module probes separately identified.

results.basis: Raw positive/negative evidence, uncertainty, hashes and FULL-REPORT.md captured.

decision.basis: Pursue lean Hybrid and HEVC Software; module component feasible with remaining integration work; default-all preparation not recommended.

record.reason: Lean Hybrid and HEVC Software meet compressed-size and startup thresholds on qualified profiles. True deferred codec loading is component-proven; production mpv integration remains separate.

lean_hybrid.scope: Chrome HEVC primary; tested H264/VP9/AV1; VP8 color oracle excluded

software_common_v2.scope: Not preferred for this HEVC target; misses 20 percent size threshold despite measured network gain

software_hevc.scope: Firefox user HEVC file; inspected full fallback and runtime reopen prototype

lazy_codec_modules.scope: PIC H264/parser component works in Chrome/Firefox; actual-player integration not qualified

prepare_all_default.scope: Higher upfront cost and slow-link timeout; retain as explicit fallback-latency tradeoff

next_action: Review and implement qualified finite engine bundles with immutable cache identities and full fallback; independently qualify any later actual-player codec-module integration.

qualification.scope: Production/release qualification; bounded research gates are recorded separately.

initial_definition.hypothesis: Avoid eagerly shipping software video decoders in a browser-video Hybrid runtime.
initial_definition.scope_contract: PLAN.md; isolated builds and explicit browser trials only.
initial_definition.baseline: Full Hybrid with matched link settings; shipping snapshot for metadata-only stripping.
initial_definition.success_criteria: 20% lower gzip Hybrid bytes plus 10% and 100ms startup gain after bounded correctness.
initial_definition.stop_criteria: Wrong output, lost fallback, or setup exceeding the bounded experiment.
initial_definition.primary_metric: Compressed bytes and selection-to-verified startup milliseconds.
initial_definition.negative_control: Wrong picture oracle; Firefox unsupported HEVC fallback.
initial_definition.effort_limit: One pruned registry build, one strip candidate, targeted tests.
